nodes.label: Laag — schildersbedrijf template
nodes.rationale: Maatwerk-tier services template (Hanken Grotesk, light, teal accent). Archetype C: split hero (text | colour picker) plus asymmetric editorial service grid, steps band, guarantee list and validated quote form. Availability line switches text based on business hours.

nodes.label: Interactive colour picker that retints the room photo
nodes.rationale: Signature feature: swatch buttons write a CSS custom property --c consumed by a tint overlay with mix-blend-mode:multiply over the room photo, so the wall colour changes live. Swatches carry aria-pressed state and paint-name/code badge updates — lets a visitor 'try' paint colours, directly supporting the quote CTA.

nodes.label: Vertical side-rail navigation
nodes.rationale: Fixed full-height dark rail on the left with vertical (writing-mode vertical-rl, rotated) logo, nav links and phone number; content shell offset by --rail width. On mobile the rail collapses into a sticky top bar with burger menu.

nodes.label: Inline form-validation pattern (blur + submit, .fld.bad + .err)
nodes.rationale: Reusable vanilla-JS pattern: required inputs validate on blur and on submit (email via regex), toggling a .bad class on the wrapping .fld to reveal an inline .err message; first invalid field gets focus, and successful submit swaps the form to a .sent state showing a confirmation. No dependencies, novalidate on the form so styling is fully controlled.
